subject: [PATCH 04/60] mm/page_alloc: build zonelists from common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new local-only zonelist for nodes outside the N_MEMORY_COMMON set, reusing code from the build_local_zonelist() refactor. This change aims to optimize memory allocation decisions based on node capabilities.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch refactors the build_zonelists() function to create zonelists from common memory, reducing unnecessary allocations and improving performance. It introduces a new local-only zonelist for nodes outside the N_MEMORY_COMMON set, reusing code from the build_local_zonelist() refactor. The changes aim to optimize memory allocation decisions based on node capabilities.
